summary: I build responsive web interfaces and automate Excel reports with Python. My portfolio also includes three educational security investigations, documented residential electrical work and three iPhone repairs. I bring a practical approach: organize the task, document the process and present evidence of the result.

Entry-level cybersecurity candidate with three documented LetsDefend investigations covering VPN authentication, RDP brute force and phishing. I correlate events, organize evidence and write investigation findings and response playbooks. I am studying Linux and preparing for the AWS Cloud Practitioner exam, with Python reporting projects as complementary practice.

I build responsive interfaces with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and automate Excel reporting with Python. Nine public projects show reusable components, API integration, browser storage and bilingual navigation. I apply Git/GitHub workflows, TypeScript checks and browser validation in my portfolio, supported by partial software development studies at Academlo.

I have completed documented residential outlet, switch and ceiling-light replacements, plus installation-board and float-switch course practice. I interpret electrical drawings and practice AC/DC measurement and circuit checks. My main training is ongoing at Universidad Internacional · RED CONOCER, reinforced by Udemy and LinkedIn Learning.

I am studying Basic Electronics at Escuela Tecnológica de Occidente, with course practice in component identification, instrument use, circuit interpretation and diagnosis. LIDETEC smartphone-repair coursework and three documented iPhone interventions complement this training. I am seeking an assistant or laboratory trainee opportunity while I develop my electronics skills.

I have completed three documented iPhone repairs: batteries on the 12 Pro and 14 Pro, and a display on the XR. I record each case and confirm post-repair functional checks. My LIDETEC participation certificate supports practical coursework in diagnosis, disassembly, measurement and repair; I am also studying Basic Electronics at ETO.

Bilingual professional with 7 years in customer service, technical support, training and operations at TCS, TTEC, Alorica and TP. I currently supervise operations, follow SLA commitments and coordinate incident escalation. My experience combines English/Spanish communication, mobile-device troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and technical training.
